sources.title: Task list operation
sources.locator: STATUSES planned/active/done/archived; ATTENTION_FILTERS blocked/waiting_user/handoff/unassigned; pagination; tasks_version
sources.finding: Daemon task store supports planned/active/done/archived statuses, blocked/waiting_user/handoff/unassigned attention filters, assignee/query filtering and optimistic tasks_version concurrency.

sources.title: Context batch operations
sources.locator: task operations with optimistic concurrency; task_conflict errors; foreman-gated task ops
sources.finding: Task mutations run as validated batches with compare-and-swap revisions and explicit task_conflict errors; role-gated so agent task operations follow the foreman/peer permission policy.

sources.title: Actor delivery worker
sources.locator: retry limits; claimed/accepted/failed/ambiguous delivery settlement
sources.finding: Deliveries carry bounded retry limits; daemon-settled claims without outcome become ambiguous and are not auto-retried; failed provider turns release the next delivery after their retry limit.

sources.title: Automation rules
sources.locator: interval/cron/one-time triggers; max_runs; paused/stopped/idle semantics
sources.finding: Automation supports interval, cron and one-time triggers with optional max_runs; paused/stopped groups run none, idle groups suppress the built-in stand-up, resume restarts clocks.

sources.title: Slash skill dispatch
sources.locator: skill:-prefixed capability IDs; task_text/command forwarding
sources.finding: Agents invoke skill: capabilities via slash dispatch with fixed send mode; skills are installed capability packs, not free-form plugins.

sources.title: Capability import
sources.locator: local path/URL/GitHub install; provenance records; unverified old search results excluded
sources.finding: Capabilities install from explicit local path, URL or GitHub target with recorded provenance; remote search results stay unverified until imported from a trusted origin.
